claim.claim-text: 1. A medicament delivery compartment, adapted to be attached to a vibrating ingestible capsule having a first housing portion and adapted to operate in a vibrating mode of operation, for delivery of a flowable ingestible medicament into the gastrointestinal tract of a user, the medicament delivery compartment including:
2. The medicament delivery compartment of claim 1, wherein said valve is configured to enable flow through said conduit when the vibrating ingestible capsule is in the vibration mode of operation.

3. The medicament delivery compartment of claim 1, wherein at least one valve parameter of the valve is set such that the valve functions as a gear reducer, so as to open and close at a frequency smaller than a frequency of vibration of the vibrating ingestible capsule.

4. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the second housing portion includes an attachment mechanism for mutual attachment to a corresponding attachment mechanism of the first housing portion of the vibrating ingestible capsule.
5. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the flexible and collapsible medicament reservoir has a maximal volume in the range of 1 mm<3> to 600 mm<3>.

6. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 5, wherein the reservoir biasing mechanism includes a reservoir spring terminating in a pressure applying surface, the pressure applying surface engaging an exterior surface of the medicament reservoir, the reservoir spring optionally being anchored to the second housing portion.
7. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the reservoir biasing mechanism has a spring constant in the range of 1 N/m to 200 N/m.
8. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein a recovery time of the conduit is:
9. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the conduit has at least one, and optionally both, of:
a diameter in the range of 0.01mm to 0.9mm; and a length in the range of 3mm to 25mm.
10. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the conduit is at least one of, and optionally both of, flexible and resilient.
11. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the valve biasing mechanism is adapted to be anchored to the second housing portion.
12. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the valve biasing mechanism has a spring constant in the range of 0.1 N/m to 5 N/m.
13. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the weight has a mass in the range of 0.1 grams to 2 grams.

14. The medicament delivery compartment of any one of claims 1 to 13, further including the flowable ingestible medicament disposed within the medicament reservoir, and optionally, the flowable ingestible medicament has a viscosity in the range of 100 Pa-s to 1000 Pa·s.
15. The medicament delivery compartment of claim 14, wherein the flowable ingestible medicament is absorbable in at least one of the stomach of the user and the small intestine of the user.
